name: hide-sensitive
description: Masks API keys, tokens, passwords, card numbers and emails in your messages before they reach the model.

maskKeys.title: Mask keys and passwords
maskKeys.description: Mask API keys, tokens, JWTs, private keys and password=... values.

maskEmail.title: Mask email addresses
maskEmail.description: Replace email addresses with a [hidden:email] box.

maskPhone.title: Mask phone numbers
maskPhone.description: Mask +country-code numbers and Vietnamese mobile numbers.

maskCard.title: Mask card numbers
maskCard.description: Mask 13 to 19 digit numbers that pass the Luhn check.

extraPatterns.title: Extra patterns
extraPatterns.description: Your own regular expressions to mask, comma separated. Example: EMP-\d{6},ACME-[A-Z0-9]{8}
